mapper.select: SELECT e.MEMBER_NO, EMPLOYER_NO, BUSINESS_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, BUSINESS_NAME, BUSINESS_ADDRESS, MEMBERSHIP_LEVEL, MEMBER_EMAIL, MEMBER_PW, MEMBER_NAME, MEMBER_TEL, TO_CHAR(ENROLL_DATE, 'YYYY"년" MM"월" DD"일" HH24"시" MI"분" SS"초"') ENROLL_DATE, AUTHORITY FROM "EMPLOYER" e JOIN "MEMBER" m ON(e.MEMBER_NO = m.MEMBER_NO) WHERE MEMBER_EMAIL = #{memberEmail} AND MEMBER_DEL_FL = 'N'
